overview: The board re-elected its slate of officers, reviewed quarterly financials, and approved a standardized funding application template. Trustees also received updates on city housing initiatives and voted to cancel their December meeting.

items.title: Trustee Introductions
items.summary: The board welcomed new trustee Megan Kelly and members shared background introductions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 2 board meeting and the September 9 fundraising working group meeting.

items.title: Annual Meeting Officer Elections and Working Groups
items.summary: Elected Lisa Davidson as chair, Penelope Taylor as vice chair, and Kayla Lessen as treasurer, and confirmed Teda DeRosa and Megan Kelly for the fundraising working group.

items.title: Quarterly Financial Report
items.summary: Reviewed third-quarter financials showing $376,129 in unencumbered cash, $200,000 reserved for a Medford Community Housing loan, and pending incoming transfers.

items.title: Housing Resource Fair Summary
items.summary: Staff reported on the housing resource fair, which featured 16 organizations and over 50 attendees.

items.title: Linkage Fee Nexus Study Update
items.summary: Staff provided an update that City Council drafted linkage fee ordinance language and referred it to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Fractional Payment Ordinance Update
items.summary: Staff reported that the fractional payment ordinance has taken effect.

items.title: Affordable Housing Incentive Bonus
items.summary: Staff updated the board on the Community Development Board's ongoing review to clean up affordable housing development incentive tables across rezoned districts.

items.title: Trust Funding Application Template
items.summary: Approved the developer funding application template subject to minor adjustments aligning AMI eligibility thresholds.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Presentation
items.summary: Staff previewed the trust's upcoming presentation to the Community Preservation Committee for fiscal year 2027 funding.

items.title: City-Owned Parcel Disposition
items.summary: Trustees discussed the potential role of the trust in utilizing city-owned parcels for affordable housing and examined regional practices and federal housing frameworks.

items.title: Project Pipeline and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Staff noted an anticipated future funding request for Walkling Court phase two, and the board voted to cancel its December meeting.
